environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnet. MongoDB Atlas accessible via VPC peering. S3 bucket 'sensitive-reports-prod' has a permissive bucket policy allowing GetObject for any principal within the AWS account. No VPC endpoint for S3 — traffic routes through NAT gateway. The /api/v1/reports/lookup endpoint is exposed via internal ALB with no authentication middleware. MongoDB user has readWrite on reporting_service database.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway for S3 access
config.s3_access: IAM role attached to ECS task with s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::sensitive-reports-prod/*
config.alb: Internal ALB, no WAF, no auth
